objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote:
What remains, apart from the initial portion of length $d$, consists of two arrays, each with at most $s$ column-blocks and each of total length at most
\[
\frac{T-d}{2}=(2^s-1)d.
\]
objection.witness: Proof of lemma (i) is unverifiable and internally inconsistent: it asserts the two post-cancellation arrays have totals summing to T-d yet each at most (T-d)/2 (forcing exact equality, which fails in examples), and that each has 'at most s column-blocks'. 'Arrays'/'column-blocks' are never defined, nor is it shown that cuts in these derived objects correspond to legal cuts of the actual pieces, so the induction cannot be checked.
